snippet.title: Momoiro Closet Opening Movie
snippet.description:
Opening video for Frontwing visual novel, "Momoiro Closet", released on April 27th, 2018.

Producer: Ryuichiro Yamakawa
Art/Character Design: INO
Frill & Lace Character Design: Akio Watanabe
Story: Yuhi Nanao

Opening Theme: "Voila! Magic Closet"
Vocals: Haruko Momoi
Lyrics & Music: Haruko Momoi
Arrangement: Haraddy

BGM Production: Fuminori Matsumoto
